title: Cozy Craftsman Escape: Steps to 12 th South!
description:
"I'd give this place ten stars if I could." - You

This house is a quaint retreat in the middle of one of the most popular neighborhoods in Nashville, where luxury meets comfort. You will feel like a local in our dreamy craftsman cottage in the heart of 12th South. It's just a few steps away from all the action.  We want all our guests to feel at home, so we have made sure the beds are extra cozy, the chef's kitchen is fully equipped, & our patio is the backyard of your dreams!

The space
You will have the entire home to yourself.
You're sure to feel like a local in our dreamy craftsman cottage in the heart of 12 South - just steps away from all the action. We want our guests to feel at home, so we've made sure the beds are extra cozy, the chef's kitchen is fully equipped, and our patio is the backyard of your dad's dreams. It's perfect for grilling and hosting.

Where you will sleep:

The downstairs Master bedroom has a king bed and a private bathroom.
There are two bedrooms upstairs.
The first bedroom upstairs has a queen bed and a private bathroom. The second bedroom upstairs has two queen beds and a private bathroom. 
Our home features two downstairs living spaces, a wet bar, a washer and dryer on both floors and an upstairs bonus room. 
There is a pullout couch upstairs that also has access to a bathroom.

We hear "Pictures don't do this place justice!" -from our guests a lot! We rlove that.

Guest access
While we cannot accommodate early check-ins or check-outs, we allow guests to drop their bags off after noon the day of check-in. Are you coming into town in the early morning or have a late flight and want to store your luggage? Let us know and we will connect you with our luggage concierge service and give you our promo code.

Other things to note
IMPORTANT DETAILS and HOUSE RULES:
- Before booking, please read/ understand the cancellation policy. We strongly recommend purchasing trip cancellation/travel insurance as we do not refund for cancellations outside of the policy listed.
- Parties and/ or Events are not permitted at this property & may result in the removal of your group from the premises without a refund.

House Rules
Minimum Booking Age: 25 years old.
No Pets: Pets are NOT allowed.
No Locals: Local guests are not permitted.
No Parties or Events: Only registered guests are allowed in the home.
No Smoking: Smoking is prohibited inside the home and on the property.
No Weapons: Weapons of any kind are not permitted in our home or on our property. 
No Rearranging Furniture: Please do not move furniture.
No Confetti or Tape: Please do not use tape or adhesive, of any kind, on our walls. *Damages will be charged to you.*
